definitions.explanation: The first and smallest planet in the Solar System, closest to the Sun. Named after the element water (水) in the Chinese five-element system.

examples.japanese: {水星|すいせい}は{太陽|たいよう}に{最|もっと}も{近|ちか}い{惑星|わくせい}だ。
examples.english: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

examples.japanese: {水星|すいせい}は{肉眼|にくがん}では{見|み}えにくい。
examples.english: Mercury is hard to see with the naked eye.

examples.japanese: {水星|すいせい}の{表面温度|ひょうめんおんど}は{昼|ひる}と{夜|よる}で{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The surface temperature of Mercury varies greatly between day and night.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone {彗星|すいせい} (comet). Both are read すいせい but written with different kanji and have completely different meanings.

NAMING:
Part of the Chinese five-element planet naming system. Wednesday ({水曜日|すいようび}) is associated with Mercury, paralleling Western tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水星|すいせい}の{軌道|きどう} (Mercury's orbit)
- {水星|すいせい}{探査|たんさ} (Mercury exploration)
- {水星|すいせい}の{公転周期|こうてんしゅうき} (Mercury's orbital period)
